Name: DGR 107 - KHAGAN
Information:
**DGR 107 - KHAGAN**

Built as a show of force more than anything else, the KHAGAN unit was created as a military deterrent. Even to the resourceful framebilt forces of High Wave and EXO-SEC, the resources needed to construct a KHAGAN unit are a major drain and are difficult to source. However, the sight of these titanic scorpion-like DGR units makes it clear that the modern framebilt are walking in their ancestors footsteps, and its military might as a fortress-busting unit is unquestioned.

traits.name: Anti-Air Siege Beast
traits.description: The DGR has advantage on attacks made against creatures or vehicles that are in flight at least 100 feet above it. It also deals double damage to structures and vehicles.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The DGR makes three attacks: two with its Slam, and one with its Laser Stinger or Eidorocket Salvo.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Macro Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage (macro damage: 25 bludgeoning damage). If the target is Large or smaller, the first time it is hit by this attack each turn it must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Laser Stinger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (5d12 + 7) radiant damage.

actions.name: Eidorocket Salvo
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, range 400/1600 ft., two targets. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 7) fire damage.
